scope: Actual local Worker/DO/D1 and Chromium using built sidebar changes; mock GitHub and synthetic execution.

threads.mode: real local Worker/D1; no model, GitHub, or container execution

steps.step: Create a custom bot through its form and persist it in the local Worker
Start a fresh bot-associated thread and select its profile in the composer
Failed rename shows an error and preserves the existing thread name
Retry saves the new name through the real session PATCH API
Refresh preserves the renamed thread and restores its bot profile on selection
Switching to the protected default session clears the bot; returning restores it
The bot card lists and reopens its persisted associated conversation
The rename form focuses its field and closes with Escape
Thread composer renders at 390px without horizontal page overflow

lifecycle.mode: real local Bots UI/auth/API/D1; composer submission and human approval UI; synthetic execution; mock GitHub

steps.step: Create a configured bot through the UI; persist harness, model, instructions, and repository
Edit to version 2 and verify profile controls survive refresh
Launch a bot conversation and reopen it from the bot's own thread history
A failed bot submission shows the error, restores the draft, and creates no approval
Composer retry queues the exact bot/session/configuration with the same command ID and freezes version 2 before approval
Editing the profile to version 3 does not rewrite the pending approved inputs
A browser click grants the human approval; no automatic profile policy bypass
Synthetic execution completes with the frozen profile version 2 and route despite the live profile being version 3
Conversation history shows the frozen bot version and scopes review/PR reads without false missing-run errors
Archive blocks new threads and runs while preserving access to the existing conversation
Restore retains the latest editable profile and the older run's frozen provenance and conversation history
